semiconductor_relevance: High — PLSINTEC provides critical metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on advanced chip types.
summary: PLSINTEC (SUZHOU) CORPORATION specializes in semiconductor front-end metrology solutions, offering advanced inspection tools and metrology systems. Their products focus on measuring thin film thickness and critical dimensions, enhancing yield for silicon-based logic, memory, and power/RF chips using SiC and GaN.
capabilities: Metrology systems for thin film thickness
